import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    
    # Fix label variants in 'species'
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df.loc[df['species'] == 'Chinstarp', 'species'] = 'Chinstrap'
    
    # Convert 'year' to string to avoid date parsing issues
    df['year'] = df['year'].astype(str)
    
    # Convert text numbers to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove rows with negative or out-of-range values in 'flipper_length_mm'
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    
    # Remove rows with out-of-range values in 'body_mass_g'
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by island and count the number of penguins
    island_counts = df.groupby('island').size().to_dict()
    return island_counts
